codeReview.summary: Clean implementation of delete entity UI with confirmation dialog, proper loading/error states, and 9 comprehensive tests. Follows existing patterns (RemoveRelationDialog in relations-panel.tsx). All validation assertions VAL-DEL-001 through VAL-DEL-007 are satisfied at the code level. No new test failures introduced (15 pre-existing failures remain unchanged). TypeScript compilation and lint pass.

issues.description: Test 'confirm fires deleteEntity mutation with correct params' verifies mutateAsync is called but does not assert that navigate('/entities') is called after successful mutation. The MemoryRouter wrapper lacks a Routes configuration, so useNavigate would not trigger a route change even if called. The navigation logic exists in source code (entity-page.tsx:93) but is untested. VAL-DEL-004 specifies navigation to /entities on success.

Test 'shows spinner and disables buttons during pending' uses a raw DOM querySelector to find buttons instead of using data-testid attributes. The confirm button already has data-testid='confirm-delete-button', but Cancel lacks one. Minor consistency improvement would be to query by test ID directly.

handleConfirm calls deleteEntity.reset() before navigate('/entities'). If navigate triggers a component unmount before the reset takes effect (unlikely but possible in React concurrent mode), the reset may not complete. Harmless in practice since the component unmounting on navigation would clean up the hook state anyway.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker had to add useCreateRelation and useDeleteRelation mocks because EntityPage renders RelationsPanel which depends on those hooks. This is a cross-component dependency issue: entity-page.test.tsx tests the full page component which transitively loads RelationsPanel. The skill may want to document that integration tests of page components need to mock all mutation hooks used by child components.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows initial test failures due to missing mocks, skillFeedback.deviations documents this. entity-page.tsx imports RelationsPanel which uses useCreateRelation/useDeleteRelation from use-mutations.ts.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker followed the established pattern of using data-testid attributes for test selectors (delete-entity-button, confirm-delete-button, delete-entity-error). This convention is consistent across the codebase but not documented in AGENTS.md.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: entity-page.tsx uses data-testid='delete-entity-button', data-testid='confirm-delete-button', data-testid='delete-entity-error'. Similar pattern in edit-entity-page.tsx with 'edit-entity-button'.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly used getAllByText instead of getByText when checking for text that appears in multiple locations (entity name in both header and dialog). This is a pattern worth noting for future test writers.

summary: The delete-entity-ui feature is well-implemented. The DeleteEntityDialog component follows existing project patterns (modeled after RemoveRelationDialog), uses shadcn Dialog properly, handles loading/error/confirmation states, and includes 9 tests covering all key behaviors. Button visibility is correctly gated on entity status === 'alive'. One non-blocking gap: the navigation-to-/entities-after-success path is not tested due to MemoryRouter limitations, though the source code correctly implements it. VAL-DEL-001 through VAL-DEL-005 and VAL-DEL-007 are fully verified by tests. VAL-DEL-006 (deleted status in list) relies on the mutation hook's cache invalidation and the existing StatusBadge component — it's correct by composition but not directly tested in this feature's scope.
